title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full Workload Backup policies for SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange
summary: The briefing passes: its coverage, opt-in state, pricing, controls and rollout dates are supported. The exclusion upload instruction remains documented despite the pre-check's wording mismatch. One minor clarification should narrow the Backup Administrator's 'entire tool' description to the three workloads, since the updated roles table also includes Entra.

claims.claim: The SharePoint creation control is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft 365 Backup > Back up sites > All sites.
claims.quote: Select Settings. Select Microsoft 365 Backup from the list of products. On Microsoft 365 Backup dashboard, select Back up sites, and then choose All sites.
